name: Low-Beta Defensive Tilt
description: Tilts portfolio toward low-beta (low systematic risk) assets and away from high-beta assets. Estimates each asset's trailing beta to IWRD (world equities) and equal-weights the lowest-beta assets. Implements the long-only leg of the Betting-Against-Beta (BAB) factor, capturing defensive risk-reduction benefits: lower volatility and drawdown with similar or modestly lower total returns, improving risk-adjusted metrics. Naturally favors bonds (VUTY) and gold (SGLN); underweights tech (AIGC, EQQQ) and commodity futures (BRNT, CRUD).
